info.name: Async Furious API - HML/PROD
info.description: Import this collection and select either generated HML or PROD environment. Credentials, CPF, tokens and IDs are variables only.

request.description: Role: public; 400 is allowed for an intentionally invalid/state-incompatible mock.

exec: const data = pm.response.json(); pm.environment.set('customer_token', data.access_token || data.token);

request.description: Role: public; 400 is allowed for an intentionally invalid/state-incompatible mock.

exec: const data = pm.response.json(); const token = data.access_token || data.token; if (token) pm.environment.set(pm.request.name.toLowerCase().includes('receptionist') ? 'receptionist_token' : pm.request.name.toLowerCase().includes('mechanic') ? 'mechanic_token' : 'admin_token', token);
